title: Ciphertext-only mid local-window balance prior
rationale: This lane predeclares a mid-range ciphertext-only local-window balance rule before scoring any new source-backed observations. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery does not use known plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate key material, routed-key results, held-out anchor controls, source-expanded candidate screens, or public-fragment structure screens. It differs from the existing local-window balance lanes by fixing widths 5, 7, and 9 and the top 16 non-anchor positions before any future source-backed observation scoring.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched at positions selected by a predeclared mid-range local ciphertext-window balance rule before any candidate-word, route, key-material, or public-anchor-derived fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: K4 ciphertext letters only, with positions interpreted as one-based absolute ciphertext positions.
Predeclared local-window balance rule over centered ciphertext windows of widths 5, 7, and 9 using only ciphertext symbol values and position indices.
A fixed top-16 position selection rule emitted before any independent observation scoring.
evaluation_inputs: Future independently source-backed non-anchor K4 position observations with source IDs, one-based positions, notes, and rationale declared before scoring.
A committed prediction artifact generated from the predeclared mid-range ciphertext-window balance rule before evaluating independent observations.
Public anchor fragments may appear only in provenance, exclusion, or negative-control summaries, not as the primary evidence target.
controls: seeded same-size non-anchor position shuffle baseline
ciphertext-symbol shuffle baseline preserving position count and alphabet membership
multiple-comparison correction across the broader ciphertext-window-balance family and all preregistered independent lanes
archive validation requiring preregistration, prediction artifact, source-backed observation file, command metadata, and non-promotion caveat
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat all predeclared controls without post-hoc retuning
